name: salesbuildr-mcp
description: Every Salesbuildr resource as a scriptable command, plus offline margin and pipeline analytics.

salesbuildr_api_key.title: SALESBUILDR_API_KEY
salesbuildr_api_key.description: Sets SALESBUILDR_API_KEY for the Salesbuildr MCP server.

salesbuildr_tenant.title: SALESBUILDR_TENANT
salesbuildr_tenant.description: Sets SALESBUILDR_TENANT for the endpoint template variable {tenant}.

salesbuildr_base_url.title: Salesbuildr API base URL
salesbuildr_base_url.description: Full API base URL. Leave blank: the CLI builds it from SALESBUILDR_TENANT. Set it only to point at a different host.

salesbuildr_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only mode
salesbuildr_mcp_read_only.description: Set to 1 to make the MCP server refuse every write to Salesbuildr: only read tools are callable. Leave blank to allow writes (each MCP write still previews first and sends only when called again with confirm set to true).

salesbuildr_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
salesbuildr_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and sync refuses to run. Leave blank to keep the local store.

salesbuildr_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
salesbuildr_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Salesbuildr requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's built-in User-Agent.

salesbuildr_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
salesbuildr_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote or hosted deployment); at least 32 characters. Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile
printing_press_client_profile.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile. Leave blank to use the profile configured as default_client_profile.
